responsibility: Lowers executable Fortran statements into GENERIC statement trees. It translates control-flow, assignment, deallocation, entry, and label-related statements, manages scalarization and runtime checks for statement bodies, and provides the statement-level translation helpers that connect resolved gfc_code nodes to backend control flow and runtime calls.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual lowering of executable gfc_code statements into trees, including control flow, assigned labels/gotos, ENTRY handling, allocation/deallocation paths, and other statement bodies. The same-name header just declares gfc_trans_code and the specialized statement translators, including ones implemented in other trans-* source files.
